name: Purple Project 01
source:
An Umineko fan-game. It is recommended to have completed the original game before playing.

It is based [spoiler]on the Bernkastel game[/spoiler] from Episode 8. Play detective and discover the identity of the culprit(s).

[Translated from [url=https://dragonslayer4012.itch.io/purpleproject01]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
海猫粉丝游戏。建议先完成原版游戏再玩。

它是基于[spoiler]关于Bernkastel游戏[/spoiler]来自第8集。扮演侦探并查明罪魁祸首的身份。

[译自[url=https://dragonslayer4012.itch.io/purpleproject01]痒痒io[/url]]
